name: coordination/stage-consent
description: The admin-only consent op (ADR-0016 §3), which `akson stage consent <ref>` renders. One call returns the risk card AND the receipt, over the very row the receipt is minted against, so what the operator read and what the receipt authorizes cannot drift apart. The card names the digest, the byte count, and the recipient — never the payload bytes. `max_uses` is 1: one disclosure, one authorization. A coordination connection cannot reach this op at all (see refusal-forbidden-surface).

result.sentence: You are about to allow ONE outbound disclosure to your peer "partner": 16 bytes of https://byom.example/task/exchange/v1.

sections.heading: What this consent allows
lines: exactly one dispatch of the staged digest above, once (max_uses 1)
nothing else: it grants no model call, no credential, and no inbound authority
akson does not interpret these bytes — it discloses them as staged

sections.heading: Who staged it
lines: the coordination surface (akson_byom_exchange_v1), at unix time 1753574400
staging was inert: nothing has left this machine yet
